chunks: From him, from Bashshār ibn Aḥmad, from ʿAbdullāh ibn Muḥammad al-Aṣfahānī, who said:
Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام said: “Your master after me is the one who will perform salat (prayer) over me.”
He said: “And we did not know Abū Muḥammad before that.”
He said: “Then Abū Muḥammad came out and performed salat (prayer) over him.”

key_terms.أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ: Abū Muḥammad, the designated successor mentioned in the report
key_terms.صَاحِبُكُمْ: your master or leader in authority after the Imam
key_terms.فَخَرَجَ: then he came out or appeared publicly
key_terms.يُصَلِّي: to perform salat (prayer), here referring to the funeral prayer

ai.seo_question: How did Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام indicate the Imamate of Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This narration reports a sign given by Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام identifying his successor: the one who would perform the funeral salat over him. The report then states that Abū Muḥammad was not previously recognized by them, but he came forth and prayed over him, thereby manifesting his position.

en.hubeali: From him, from Bashhar Bin Ahmad, from Abdullah Bin Muhammad Al Isfahany who said,
‘Abu Al-Hassanasws said: ‘Your Masterasws after measws is the one who would pray Salat over measws’,
and we did not know Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> before that.
So Abu Muhammadasws came out and prayed Salat over himasws’.
en.sarwar: 3. From him has narrated from Bashshar ibn Ahmad from ‘Abdallah ibn Muhammad al-Isfahani who has said the following. “
Abu al-Hassan (a.s.) said, “Your master (Imam) after me will be the one who will perform prayer for me (prayer for burial).”
The narrator has said that we did not know abu Muhammad (a.s.) before this.
Abu Muhammad came out and prayed (for his burial).”
